inputs.text: You won't believe what they're saying about this massive anti-Trump protest that kicked off as a huge "No Kings" rally. Crowds packed the streets and then federal officers suddenly moved in with tear gas and arrests, turning everything volatile while they blamed agitators for squaring off with authorities and ordered people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver, but that's just the surface. This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to manufacture chaos, discredit real opposition, and tighten their grip under the guise of restoring order. Don't trust the official spin for a second—it's all inverted to serve their interests.
